comments.author: @BobbyStanaland
comments.text: I farmed watermelon, cucumbers, and honeydew melons in Belize in 1987 and 1988.  Our farm was at Orange Walk.  Some will remember.  Later, my brother raised water buffalo.  It was fun, but not much money was made.  Don't leave your clothes drying outside overnight.  Thieving is not a sin. I would like to go back to find my friends.

replies.author: @BobbyStanaland
replies.text: @TassiaD1 I lived in northern Belize, in the Orange Walk district.  I lived near Mexico.  Chetumal, Quintana Roo, is a large modern city.  I needed my passport stamped every 30 days.  I would clear customs with my passport stamped.  I thought living in Corozal in northern Belize would be my choice.  Belize has many options.
